title: Track A — Activate SQLite v0 Memory + Consult System
description: Activate JANUS's memory architecture on SQLite v0. Four scientists converged: JANUS has a fully designed entity schema (Decision, Rejection, Error, Pattern, Convention) but none of it is wired into the orchestrator's decision flow. Resilience score: 22/100. ~8-16K tokens wasted per session on re-discovery. This mission creates the context files, moves entity tools to the active tools directory, backfills the error log, wires 3 consult points into the orchestrator, wires write-back into mission completion, and auto-refreshes world_env.json. The storage backend (SQLite) is deliberately swappable to neural when the LCN Brain passes Phase C validation.

features.name: Create .opencode/context/ seed files
features.description: 8+ agent prompts reference .opencode/context/ files that don't exist. Create 4 seed files: project-overview.md (architecture, tech stack, conventions), decisions.md (architectural decisions log), conventions.md (code style, import patterns, naming), and a feature template. These are compression-immune — they survive context pruning across sessions.
acceptance_criteria: .opencode/context/project-overview.md exists with architecture overview, tech stack, directory layout, key conventions, design decisions
.opencode/context/decisions.md exists with at least 3 decisions logged (model choice, agent roster, memory architecture)
.opencode/context/conventions.md exists with code style rules, import patterns, naming conventions, testing patterns
.opencode/context/feature-MEMORY-V0.md exists with this mission's plan skeleton
All files use the standard context file format (Purpose, Key Decisions, Files Touched, Constraints, Notes)

features.name: Move and refurbish entity tools to active directory
features.description: Entity tools exist as reference implementations (MagnumOpus/reference/lcn_write.py, MagnumOpus/reference/capability_assessor.py) and specs (tests/test_lcn_read.py, tests/test_lcn_write.py). Move them to .opencode/tools/, build the missing consult.py orchestrator helper, and ensure all 5 entity types (Decision, Rejection, Error, Pattern, Convention) have read/write paths.
acceptance_criteria: .opencode/tools/lcn_write.py exists and imports correctly (moved from MagnumOpus/reference/)
.opencode/tools/capability_assessor.py exists (moved from reference)
.opencode/tools/lcn_read.py exists with 5 query types: similar_decisions, related_errors, applicable_conventions, entity_by_key, recent_by_type
.opencode/tools/consult.py exists with 3 modes: pre_plan, pre_dispatch, post_verify — each queries the entity store and returns structured context
All 4 tools have valid Python syntax and can be imported
Existing tests under tests/ still pass (or are updated to new paths)

features.name: Backfill error log from lessons.md and known issues
features.description: The error log at .opencode/error-log.jsonl has 1 entry. lessons.md documents multiple incidents (Cerebras stalls, Perplexity stalls, reviewer failures, orchestrator model routing issues, Brain/ deletion incident). Backfill structured entries so the error log is useful for pattern detection. Also seed the entity store with known decisions and patterns from decisions.json and lessons.md.
acceptance_criteria: .opencode/error-log.jsonl has at least 10 entries covering Cerebras stalls, Perplexity stalls, reviewer failures, model routing issues, Brain/ deletion
Each entry has valid JSON with error_type, agent_or_tool, context, recovery, severity fields
Known decisions from .opencode/state/decisions.json are written as Decision entities to the LCN entity store
Known patterns from lessons.md are written as Pattern entities

features.name: Wire consult points into orchestrator prompt
features.description: Add 3 consult steps to .opencode/agent/orchestrator.md: (1) pre-plan — query for similar past decisions and applicable patterns, (2) pre-dispatch — query for known pitfalls with the agent/model being dispatched, (3) post-verify — check for applicable conventions after a feature completes. Each step is ≤10 lines and gated by a JANUS_CONSULT_ENABLED env-compatible flag. Also update the SESSION START to read context files.
acceptance_criteria: orchestrator.md SESSION START step 2b reads .opencode/context/*.md files
orchestrator.md has consult step before planning (pre-plan, queries similar decisions + patterns)
orchestrator.md has consult step before dispatch (pre-dispatch, queries known pitfalls for target agent/model)
orchestrator.md has consult step after feature completion (post-verify, queries applicable conventions)
All consult steps are gated: skip if consult.py missing or JANUS_CONSULT_DISABLED set
Global orchestrator.md at ~/.config/opencode/agents/ is synced with project copy

features.name: Wire write-back into mission completion
features.description: The mission-completion protocol skill includes a memory write-back step that has never executed because no working entity store exists. Wire it: after a mission completes, write Decision entities for each feature's architectural choices, write Error entities for any failures encountered, write Pattern entities for conventions discovered. Use lcn_write.py as the backend.
acceptance_criteria: mission-completion skill (SKILL.md) step 7 references lcn_write.py with correct path and arguments
Mission completion writes Decision entities for each feature's key architectural choices
Mission completion writes Error entities for any failures during the mission
Graceful degradation: if lcn_write.py fails, log to error-log.jsonl but don't fail the mission
Skill file at C:\Users\lukas\.config\opencode\skills\mission-completion\SKILL.md is updated

features.name: Auto-refresh world_env.json and wire session bootstrap
features.description: world_env.json is 11 days stale — it predates the entire RESTORE-2026-05-13 mission and doesn't reflect the restored git repo, 22 agents, or research files. Add an auto-refresh step to the orchestrator's SESSION START that runs python .opencode/tools/world_env.py scan when world_env.json is older than the most recent git commit.
acceptance_criteria: orchestrator.md SESSION START includes a step to check world_env.json freshness
Uses git log -1 --format=%ct to compare against world_env.json mtime
Auto-runs world_env.py scan if stale (not if Python unavailable)
world_env.json is regenerated at mission start to reflect current project state
Global orchestrator.md synced with project copy
